name: Beeminder
description: Beeminder is a goal-tracking tool that helps you stay accountable and motivated by visualizing your progress and setting up financial stakes for your goals. Whether you're looking to build a new habit, lose weight, or complete a project, Beeminder keeps you on track by integrating with various apps and services.

events.d: Same as “List All Goals,” but returns goals you’ve archived.
Fetch all details for one goal. Include &datapoints=true to get its full datapoint history.
Returns datapoints (entries) logged under a goal.
Retrieves all active goals of the specified user.
Charges a specified amount (USD) to the user’s account, with an optional note
Removes the specified datapoint from the goal.
